hard_blockers.evidence_required: title or Full JD explicitly identifies PhD student/doctoral student/trainee role
France faculty title such as Maître de conférences/MCF or equivalent faculty appointment
medical or nursing degree is explicitly mandatory
specific professional/clinical registration is explicitly mandatory and profile does not establish it
German C1/C2 is explicitly mandatory for teaching duties
patch clamp is a core mandatory method
optogenetics is a core mandatory method
specialist wet-lab expertise absent from declared profile is explicitly mandatory and central to role
advanced AI/ML/computational research expertise is explicitly mandatory and central to role
Australia posting explicitly states no sponsorship and requires existing unrestricted work rights
Full JD establishes a domain materially unrelated to all A/B/C scientific tracks; title alone is insufficient

evidence_rules: A hard blocker must be supported by explicit title or Full JD evidence.
Absence of information is not blocker evidence.
Preferred/desirable requirements never trigger a hard blocker by themselves.
When detail retrieval fails, route to NEEDS_DETAIL_REVIEW rather than POLICY_SKIP.
